Napoli Knights edged past Milan Icons by 3 wickets in a low-scoring thriller in Match 8 of the Italia T10 League 2026!
Napoli Knights bowled out Milan Icons for 44 in 9.4 overs before holding their nerve in a tense chase, reaching 47/7 in 7.3 overs to seal victory.
